main_measure.name: mean of -(forecast/10) x drift-adjusted 10-bar return on short grid bars
main_measure.threshold: confirm if mean > 0 with t >= 2; reject if mean < 0 with t <= -2

supporting_check.name: drift-adjusted 10-bar fall, larger minus smaller |forecast| half (Welch t 1.312)

decided_by: The main mean is < 0 with t <= -2: the coin rises beyond its drift after these closes.
reading: The grid is positions 0,10,20,... of each window with the 10-bar return kept inside it, the drift is each coin's mean 10-bar return on that grid over all its windows, the larger half is |forecast| strictly above the median (ties go to the smaller half), and the plan's 100-case minimum is applied as 'not observable'.
